title: Carrier-phase Doppler of 79 GPS, Galileo and GLONASS satellites at 34 IGS stations on 2025-04-10: orbits, station positions, GM and Ω fitted to the Doppler alone
verdict_rule: The stations held on one plane (tilt, height and positions free, everything else as free as on the globe) fitting the Doppler as well as the free solution; or the satellites needing different GM for their periods (Kepler's third law failing).
license_note: IGS data, BKG open archive (https://igs.bkg.bund.de): free, cite the IGS (Johnston et al. 2017). RNXCMP (crx2rnx): GSI terms, cite Hatanaka (2008).

sources.cite: IGS / BKG GNSS data centre, daily RINEX 3 observation files (30 s) and broadcast ephemeris BRDC00IGS, 2025 day 100
Johnston, G., Riddell, A., Hausler, G. (2017), The International GNSS Service, in Springer Handbook of Global Navigation Satellite Systems, 967-982
Hatanaka, Y. (2008), A Compression Format and Tools for GNSS Observation Data, Bulletin of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, 55, 21-30 (RNXCMP)
Montenbruck, O., Gill, E. (2000), Satellite Orbits: Models, Methods and Applications, Springer, §3.2-3.3 (J2 and third-body accelerations, low-precision Sun and Moon)

units.r: km, distance of a station from the force centre the orbits fit
units.lat: deg, geocentric, from the fitted position
units.lon: deg east, frame turned by the first station's catalogue longitude (an angle)
units.dcat: m, distance to the RINEX header position (comparison only, never used)
units.passes: [hour after 00:00 GPS time, observed range rate minus the receiver clock (m/s), globe model, flat model]

inputs.origin: Our fixed list of IGS stations (the same as gps-raw).
IGS broadcast ephemeris BRDC00IGS, 2025 day 100, BKG open archive (read only to start the orbits).
IGS daily RINEX 3 observation files, 2025 day 100, BKG open archive (the same files as gps-raw).

notes: The broadcast navigation file is read only to START the satellites' orbits; the stations start on a plane and GM 25 % low, and fog checks that restarts from other starts land on the same solution (restarts in the output). raw/ is the same set of files as data/gps/raw: fog fetch sat-doppler links to it when it is there, else downloads. The target is slow (about half an hour on four cores): fog build all skips it, make ci-full runs it.
